About Us
Who We Are
Kenya Safari Lodges & Hotels Ltd (“KSLH”, “The Company”) is a State Corporation that was incorporated under the Kenya Companies Act (Cap 486) in 1966 and owned through shareholding by Kenya Development Corporation Ltd (KDC), Mt. Lodge (MLL) and Kenya Wildlife Service (KWS).
The history of the Company dates back to December1969 when it started operations under the management of Hallways Hotels Ltd, a British hotel management company. Effective 1974, African Tours & Hotels Ltd became the management company of KSLH until June 1998 when the contract ended. Thereafter, KSLH took over the running and management of its 3 properties namely:
Mombasa Beach Hotel
Voi Safari Lodge
Ngulia Safari Lodge
KSLH Key Strategic Direction (2021-2025)
KSLH conducts its business within the requirements of all the relevant Acts of Parliament including the EMCA (1999), the Hotels and Restaurant Act Caps 494 and the State Corporation Act (Cap 484) with the core mandate being;
To promote tourist trade in Kenya and beyond, establish facilities for tourist convenience.
To publicize and advertise the attractions and amenities for KSLH for tourists.
To establish and manage KSLH for the convenience of tourists.
To promote wildlife conversation and development
To establish any other related business that promote and adds value to KSLH.
The KSLH Strategic plan sets out four broad strategic imperatives to establish a commonly shared vision for the future of KSLH and of its role in the broader mission of enhancing customer value by offering top quality hospitality experiences.
Vision
To be the preferred hospitality destination of choice
Mission
To enhance customer value by offering top quality hospitality experiences
Our Mandate
These are standards of ethical behavior or fundamental beliefs that shape an organization's culture. They describe the

Integrity

Our Focus
Offering excellent customer care and experience.
Ensuring financially protected accommodation, events, meeting and conference
packages.
Providing all our services at market competitive prices.
Our Pride
KSLH is well-reputed in the hospitality industry for our robust relationship with partners and business supporter through continuous improvements to build on trust and credibility among our clients.
Our commitment is to provide our guests with the best in hospitality, affordable and memorable experiences
Our properties denote easy accessibility, convenience and attractiveness of the surroundings as key factors for guest experience offering quality services that include 24-hour front desk, concierge and room service among others. The Staff is committed to a high degree of personal attention, speed and efficiency.  Our amenities are a perfect blend of safari & serenity comprising of;
Meticulously designed modern rooms.
Dining delight in diverse international & local cuisines.
Versatile meeting & event space.
Vibrant hub of recreational activities and entertainment.
Untamed landscape & thrilling wildlife encounters.
Strategic Objectives
Financial sustainability
Enhanced customer satisfaction
Efficient business processes.
Improved operational efficiency
Core Functions
Marketing and Promotion: Ensures promotion of KSLH services in both
domestic and international markets.
Regulation and Monitoring: Includes setting standards for its various units to attract and retain high value clients.
Product Development and Diversification: Ensures development of market focused products and services that appeal to top-end tourists and business travelers.
Manpower Training and Development: Responsible for training of manpower and setting of standards to enable provision of premium customer focused services.
Liaison: Liaises with Ministry of Tourism and Wildlife, Tour Operators and Travel Agents for the provision of high-class hospitality.
Resource Mobilization: Responsible for seeking for finances from internal and external sources in consultation with Treasury for the approval of the budget.
Service: Provide world class hotel and lodge services through well trained customer focused staff, modern facilities equipped with modern hospitality infrastructure.
Profitability: Identify, anticipate and satisfy customer requirements profitably.

Our Properties
Mombasa Beach Hotel
A captivating paradise nestled along the sun-kissed shores of Mombasa, Kenya, Mombasa Beach Hotel is the classic seaside retreat that combines the charm of traditional Kenyan hospitality with the genuine allure of the coast offering a blend of modern comfort and unforgettable experiences for both leisure seekers and business travelers alike.
From the first light of dawn to the tranquil sunset, This Hidden Gem symbolizes the essence of coastal opulence, inviting you to unwind, explore, and create lasting memories in one of Kenya s most captivating destinations.
Read More
Perched on the edge of the Ndawe Escarpment, within the sprawling and majestic Tsavo West National Park, Ngulia Safari Lodge offers an unparalleled vista of Tsavo’s sweeping plains, rugged volcanic landscapes and a prime location for wildlife and birdwatching.
Here, guests immerse themselves in a haven of tranquility to experience the raw beauty of the African wilderness where the sun rises and sets to a perfect silhouette of Mount Kilimanjaro. This serene sanctuary is the ideal escape for those seeking to reconnect with nature while enjoying breathtaking views and the ultimate peace of mind.
The Pearl of Tsavo West!
Read More
Ngulia Safari Lodge
Voi Safari Lodge
Elegantly perched within the majestic sprawl of Tsavo East National Park, Voi Safari Lodge is one of the most innovatively conceived and constructed wildlife retreats in Kenya. The Lodge exemplifies cutting-edge design and architecture in Kenya’s wilderness.
From every corner, guests are treated to unique panoramic and spectacular views of diverse wildlife frequenting the nearby water holes, making it the ideal spot for nature enthusiasts to capture the essence of the park’s breathtaking landscapes.
The Pride of Tsavo East!
